description.value: Superflux Cabana is a craft beer bar and restaurant in Victoria, BC, operated by Superflux Beer Company as their 'island outpost.' Located upstairs at 804 Broughton Street, the 110-seat venue features two rooftop patios and an indoor lounge styled after a 1970s Vegas hotel bar, with the latest Superflux beers always on tap and a full late-night kitchen serving burgers and casual fare.
